tools.name: auth_status
tools.description: Whether this session is signed in to Vamos. When it is not, returns the sign-in link to give the user.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Free. What this workspace already has, so setup and tracking aren't redone: plan, Brain files and skills, voice guide, tracked accounts and the cap, routines. `file` returns one file's text or skill's instructions.

tools.name: save_brain_file
tools.description: Free. Saves one Brain file to this workspace, replacing the one with that title or creating it. With when_to_use, a skill instead.

when_to_use.description: Makes it a skill: the kind of task it is for.

tools.name: set_up_workspace
tools.description: Set up the workspace this connection signed in to: from their social accounts, website and what they do, Vamos fills in their Brain (profile, pillars and voice) and follows creators in their niche. Ask them for these first. Returns a runId; poll it with chat_completion_poll.

about.description: What they do, what they sell and who it is for, in their words, if they said.

accounts.description: Their social accounts: @handle with the platform, or profile links (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Facebook).

competitors.description: Competitors' accounts or sites they named.

track.description: Creators they named to track; else Vamos picks up to six.

website.description: Their website, if they have one.

tools.name: get_credit_usage
tools.description: The workspace's plan and remaining Vamos credits. Free to call.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description: The workspace's Vamos chats, most recent first, with titles. Continue the chat that matches the user's work; create_chat is for new work. Scheduled routine runs appear here too. A non-null cursor means more pages.

workspace.description: Another of the user's workspaces, by name. Default: the connected one.

tools.name: get_messages
tools.description: A chat's messages, newest first. Free: use it to show or reuse an earlier answer, or after an error to see whether a turn landed. A non-null cursor means more pages.

include_data.description: Only when the user wants an answer's videos, ads, creators and formats as rows: each answer gains them in `data`; limit defaults to 5, max 20.

include_transcripts.description: With include_data: add transcripts, up to 10.

tools.name: create_chat
tools.description: Start a new Vamos chat for new work and get its chatId. Every later message in the chat builds on the ones before it.

prompt.description: A short name for the chat, not the request: send that with the first message.

workspace.description: Another of the user's workspaces, by name. Default: the connected one.

tools.name: chat_completion_start
tools.description:
Ask Vamos to research or write social media content: what is working on TikTok, Instagram or YouTube (trending formats, hooks and topics in a niche, content ideas, a creator's or competitor's best posts, creators to work with), a post's hook, comments or video, whether a post or idea is worth posting, a brand's Meta ads and creator program, a content strategy, and posts, hooks, scripts or captions in their brand voice; or to keep what the user asks it to (a brand fact, a voice rule, creators to track, a routine).

Returns a runId at once while Vamos works: seconds for a rewrite, 2-8 minutes for research. Call chat_completion_poll with the runId until it is done; the answer is its `result`. Send the next message in a chat after that: one sent while a run works starts a second run.

Credits bill when the run completes, at most 60 a run, even if you stop polling; chat_completion_cancel stops it.

client_context.description: Tracking only: the plugin (name@version) and skill sending this.

content.description: The user's whole request in their own words, as one message even when it has several parts, with the details it depends on (their niche, platform, offer, handles or links; for a video they attached, what it shows, its first spoken line and on-screen text word for word). One exception: send something to save as its own message, since a run that researches may not save it. Vamos plans its own research and has this chat's history and the workspace brand, so add no plan or format of your own; pass on figures the user gave or their other tools returned, such as their ad results. Examples: "break down @vanessalau.co's last 30 days", "tighten hook 2, add a stronger CTA".

data_format.description: Default: links. "inline": the rows in `data` instead, for a small set or a host that cannot fetch.

data_scope.description: With include_data. "turn": every post, ad, creator and format the research read, each with `cited`. Default: the answer's.

include_data.description: Only when the user wants the answer's videos, ads, creators and formats as rows (a sheet, board, file or pipeline); they are long. Adds `data`: row counts and 24h links to JSON and CSV. No extra credits.

include_transcripts.description: With include_data: add transcripts, up to 10.

tools.name: chat_completion_poll
tools.description:
Wait for a chat_completion_start run. The server holds each call up to 50s and returns as soon as the status changes.

`working`: call again at once, with no sleep and nothing written to the user in between. `done`: `result` is the answer; give it to the user with its links and details intact, since the links are its sources, and `answerUrl`, the full answer. `incomplete`: the same, but cut off before it finished; say so. `failed`: `error` says why. `cancelled`: stopped by chat_completion_cancel.

tools.name: chat_completion_cancel
tools.description: Stop a chat_completion_start run, e.g. when the user changes their mind or sent the wrong message. Credits cover only the work done so far. Safe to repeat.
